knownIssues.text: Specialist reports describe deterioration of the original pre-catalyst material and possible engine damage. Frequency, causal sequence and a facelift cutoff are unestablished.

prevention.text: Check oil level and ask a qualified shop to investigate oil consumption or catalyst symptoms with the emissions equipment intact.

yearChanges.text: The facelift revised the nose, lamps and tire package. The UK gearbox change does not apply to the U.S. three-pedal car.

maintenanceAccessibility.text: The mid-engine package constrains access compared with an open front-engine bay. Job-specific labor estimates remain unresearched.

driving.text: The light chassis and U.S. five-speed retain the original appeal. The facelift tire and chassis changes need direct U.S. manual testing to justify a separate rating.

styling.text: Revised lamps and openings give the compact body more definition, though the tall lamp clusters still dominate the nose.

character.enthusiastAppeal: The mid-engine layout makes a modest powertrain feel lively on an ordinary road.
character.idealBuyer: A weekend driver who values agility and can accommodate little luggage.
character.avoidIf: You need usable luggage space or want minimal used-car inspection effort.
